title: Implement coupled thermo-chemo-mechanical solver
action: Implement a 2D finite-element solver for the coupled oxygen diffusion and mechanical response described in the paper (damage-dependent diffusivity, generalized Johnson-Cook model, penalty-based scale bridging, staggered coupling algorithm).

title: Compute steady-state temperature field
action: Compute the steady-state temperature distribution in the plate using the implemented heat conduction solver with the specified top-surface heat flux (nominal 1.0 W/mm², elevated to 6.5 W/mm² at centre) and fixed bottom temperature of 149 °C.

title: Run coupled chemo-mechanical simulations for all stress levels
action: For each stress amplitude (0, 605, 610, 611, 612, 613, 614, 615 MPa), run the coupled chemo-mechanical simulation for 400 h using the steady-state temperature field, initial oxygen concentration 0.15 wt%, surface concentration 10 wt%, and the material parameters from the paper. Ramp load to target in first hour; hold constant thereafter.

title: Extract maximum alpha-case depths and produce results CSV
action: For each stress amplitude, extract the maximum alpha-case depth (distance from top surface to deepest point with oxygen concentration ≥ 4.5 wt%) from the final concentration field at t = 400 h. Write the results to alpha_case_depths.csv.
description: CSV with columns stress_MPa and max_depth_um, one row per stress amplitude in ascending order.
output_schema: columns: stress_MPa (numeric), max_depth_um (numeric); one row for each of 0,605,610,611,612,613,614,615 MPa
